description: PAID ($0.001 USDC via x402, paid automatically). Is this address worth sending to? Syntax, the domain's DNS (MX, then A/AAAA), disposable-provider and role-mailbox lists, a free-provider flag, a typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com), a normalized form (Gmail dots and +tags collapsed), and a risk verdict — low / medium / high / undeliverable — with reasons. No SMTP probe: it vouches for the DOMAIN, never the mailbox. An invalid address is a paid verdict (that IS the answer); a DNS failure answers 502 and is not charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

name: email_check

deliverableDomain.description: Syntax valid AND the domain accepts mail at the DNS level — a statement about the DOMAIN, never the mailbox

domainExists.description: The domain answered DNS (MX or A/AAAA); false = no such domain

hasA.description: The domain has an A/AAAA record (mail may still be accepted without MX)

isDisposable.description: The domain is on the disposable-provider list (a list, not a census)

isRole.description: A role mailbox (info@, support@, noreply@, …) rather than a person

method.description: Exactly what was checked, and that no SMTP probe was made

normalized.description: Lower-cased; for Gmail, dots and the +tag in the local part removed

reasons.description: Why: invalid_syntax, domain_not_found, domain_accepts_no_mail (a null MX, RFC 7505), no_mx_record, disposable_domain, role_mailbox, likely_typo, free_provider

risk.description: The verdict: undeliverable (bad syntax / no domain / no mail host), high (disposable), medium (role mailbox or likely typo), low

suggestion.description: A corrected address when the domain looks like a typo of a common provider, else null

syntaxValid.description: Shaped like a real mailbox address

title: Check an email address ($0.001)
